card.title: No. 1 COMMANDO
card.text: Units dealt combat damage by this unit are destroyed.
card.flavorText: The No. 1 Commando was a battalion sized unit of the British Army during WWII. The unit was formed in 1940 by men that were cherry picked from every army regiment to participate in special assignments, often behind the enemy lines where they risked being shot if captured. During the war the No. 1 Commando participated in operations in France from 1941 to 1942, but was then assigned to Operation Torch in November 1942 where it participated in the Allied landings in North Africa. The unit continued to operate in North Africa and fought in the first battle of Sedjenane in the Tunisia Campaign in 1943. In 1944 it fought as part of a Commando brigade in Burma and the Arakan, but was later withdrawn and prepared to participate in the invasion of Malaysia in 1945. However the war ended before that and the unit participated in the liberation of Hong Kong instead.
